summary: A 1934 enclosed timber tower on Shasta-Trinity NF land, still standing; the register records 2019 registration, but no staffing history was found.

facts.design: Enclosed timber tower, 13 feet, built to California Region 5 Plan BC-301
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Shasta-Trinity National Forest

visit.trail_note: Reached by the Knob Peak Lookout Road and Cow Gulch Road. A hiker's track says the road is rough but needs no four-wheel drive. The same hiker did not walk up from the gate, and the sources read do not say where the walk starts. The trail passes through or next to fenced private property near the peak.

events.note: Enclosed timber tower to California Region 5 Plan BC-301; the register gives 1934, and newspaper notes show the lookout finished that August
CCC crews working on the road to the lookout in June 1934
New paint and protective shutters; the register says 'recently' and a photo caption dates the work to 2009
Registered October 26, 2019, nominated by Brad Eells

notes_for_editor: The brief's 1934 build date and 2019 registration are confirmed. Not used: a Shasta County Fire Safe Council Facebook snippet gives 1932 (page would not load, so unverified), and a geocache listing (GC1HP35) calls the lookout abandoned (page would not render). Access to the cab interior, staffing and climbability are not in any source read. Source 4 is a single hiker's track of unknown date. The 13-foot figure is the register's own wording and may describe the tower or the cab.
